summary.prose: Building s4 adds one daemon module, src/daemon/model-check.ts, that checks an unknown Claude or Codex model through its own CLI one call at a time and records the user's decision in the approved-model store with an atomic write. The work is built inward-out: a one-line export of the registry's profile validator, the shared check machinery with the Codex procedure, the Claude procedure, the approve/reject decisions and store writer, then registering the three requests, and finally real-daemon tests that prove each decision takes effect after a restart, plus a gated live test against the installed CLIs.

tasks.title: Decisions: approveCheck / rejectCheck and the atomic store writer
tasks.summary: Add approveCheck(params, deps?) and rejectCheck(params, deps?) to model-check.ts. approve refuses unknown-check, model-did-not-run and invalid-efforts (an effort not claimed or whose verdict was rejected, or a non-string entry); reject needs only a pending check. The writer reads the store at PATHS.approvedModels (missing = new document), accepts an existing document only when it is an object with version === 1 and an array profiles, validates the new ApprovedProfile { family, modelId, status, efforts, inputLimit?, decidedAt, cliVersion } with profileProblem, appends it keeping existing entries verbatim, creates the directory, writes <store>.tmp and renames; any failure returns write-failed with the previous file unchanged and no .tmp left, and keeps the check pending. Success returns { ok: true, restartRequired: true } only after the rename and consumes the check.
acceptanceChecks: approve writes an approved profile with only the requested efforts, the check's inputLimit and cliVersion; reject writes a rejected profile with efforts []; each passes profileProblem and is read back by getModelRegistry (test seams) as user-approved / rejected
unknown-check, model-did-not-run and invalid-efforts write nothing; a consumed or evicted check returns unknown-check; approve with [] after unreadable effort discovery succeeds

A malformed store, one without version, with a string version, with version 2, and a failing rename each return write-failed, leave the previous bytes (or no file) and no .tmp, and keep the check pending
Existing entries, including ones the reader skips, are kept verbatim; a missing store and directory are created
